mock for the Accounts SDK signer abstraction. Accepts a signature whose outer envelope is ERC-7913 (`abi.encode(bytes signer, bytes rawSig)`) and whose inner `rawSig` is an ERC-7964 cross-chain envelope. This exercises the SDK path `toERC7913Signer(toCrossChainSigner(inner, ...), { address })` end-to-end: the outer envelope is peeled by this contract, and the inner cross-chain payload is verified via {CrossChainSignatureChecker}. The verifier-less shortcut is used \u2014 `signer` is required to be a 20-byte address, which is passed directly to {CrossChainSignatureChecker-isValidCrossChainSignatureNow}.
